Name: Rolling12MonthFlag
Expression:
VAR CurrentDate = 'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime]
RETURN
IF(
    'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] >= EDATE(TODAY(), -12) &&
    'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] <= TODAY(),
    1,
    0
)

Name: PreviousYearRollingFlag
Expression:
VAR CurrentDate = 'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime]
RETURN
IF(
    'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] >= EDATE(TODAY(), -24) &&
    'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] <= EDATE(TODAY(), -12),
    1,
    0
)
